description: Phase 1b of the COVID first look: the boarding axis as a declared screen on the training hull. Infection age of the index case at embarkation and the number of introductions are DECLARED assumptions in the scenario (age 0, one import); this grid reports how the pre-quarantine onset count and the first recorded onset respond to them, at the fitted Theta (covid_first_look_v2: 3.16e4) and its half-decade neighbours, on matched seeds. The declared cell is in the grid so every contrast is paired. Run with shared heads visited (transmission.sanitary_visit_mode dwell_weighted), which the replicated fit did not; the execution witness is recorded per cell.
note: 3 Theta x 3 ages x 2 import counts x 10 seeds = 180 cells. Seeds are the first ten of covid_first_look_v2's fit seeds, but the v2 cells are not a paired baseline for this screen because the visit mode differs; the age-0/one-import column is.
